# MTZ Auto Care

> Family-owned auto repair based in Pflugerville, Texas. MTZ Auto Care is a family-owned, Latino-owned repair shop on Dalshank St. Drivers say Melk and Rose explain everything, tell you what can wait, and get you back on the road fast.

- Phone: (512) 252-7229
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Service area: Pflugerville, Hutto, Round Rock, Manor, Wells Branch, Austin
- Google rating: 4.7 from 602 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/mtz-auto-care/quote.html
- Book a drop-off: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/mtz-auto-care/book.html

## Services
- Diagnostics & check engine: A real diagnosis before any parts get swapped, explained in plain language.
- Engine & timing work: Big jobs done right, from timing chains to full engine replacements.
- Brakes & suspension: Pads, rotors, CV joints and struts, with honest advice on what can wait.
- Maintenance & inspection: Oil, fluids and Texas state inspections while you wait or drop off.
- Towing to the shop: Broken down nearby? They can tow it straight to the bay.

## About
MTZ Auto Care is a family-owned shop in Pflugerville. Melk runs the bays and Rose runs the front desk. Customers say they always get to talk to the mechanic who worked on the car. Reviewers keep using the same words: honest, fair and kind. More than one says another shop quoted a transmission or a big job, and MTZ found the real, smaller problem.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you do Texas state inspections?
  A: Yes. Inspections and routine maintenance are some of the most common visits.
- Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
  A: Yes. Reviewers mention MTZ towing a broken-down car in within minutes and fixing it the same day. Call to check availability.
- Q: Can you check a used car before I buy it?
  A: Yes. Pre-purchase inspections are a regular request.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Closed weekends.
- Q: Can I bring my own parts?
  A: Call ahead and ask; the shop will tell you how they handle customer-supplied parts.
